$comment: Licence policy for dependencies (ADR 0002, with CC-BY-3.0 added by ADR 0013), checked by `pnpm check:licences`. A licence in allowedPerPackage passes only with an exception naming one package version, with the reason, approver and date; exceptions are reviewed every quarter. A development-only exception fails the check if the package reaches the production dependency tree. CC-BY-3.0 and CC-BY-4.0 are for data files only, and CC-BY-3.0 only in development dependencies.

exceptions.reason: Browser support data used by browserslist, through @babel/core in eslint-plugin-react-hooks. A data file, used only when linting; it never ships.
The SPDX list of licence exception identifiers, used by spdx-expression-parse in this licence check. A data file, used only in development and CI; it never ships.
Command-line parsing in js-yaml, through cosmiconfig in kysely-codegen, which generates the database types. Used only in development and CI; it never ships.
